Account background: Product-led mid-market SaaS (B2B search + support workflows). Heavy document ingestion (financial docs, contracts), customer-facing assistants in product UI. Primary goal: lower inference cost while maintaining sub-200ms 95th-percentile for UI assistant.

Use-case & requirements (from calls / notes):
- Workloads: mix of short chat requests (avg 40 tokens) and embeddings for search rerank. Also periodic long-context summarization jobs (avg 2k tokens).
- Latency targets: UI assistant target 95p < 200ms for simple prompts; background jobs can be higher.
- Throughput: expected peak 120 reqs/s (short chat), baseline 20 reqs/s off-peak.
- Cost sensitivity: high — CFO wants cost per 1M tokens vs current benchmark. Target: >=35% token-cost reduction vs hosted baseline using Dedicated + optimize levers.
- Model preference: open models (LLAMA-family variants) initially; open to Redwood-verified quantized footprints. Need fallbacks for service outages.
- Routing: prefer region-aware routing (NA primary) and automatic fallback to lower-cost model during heavy load.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance evidence, KMS integration, audit logs, and EU data residency for EU customers.

POC & Cost-optimization workshop notes:
- Workshop objectives: demonstrate batching + KV/prefix caching gains, show quantization profile tradeoffs (8-bit vs 4-bit), and produce unit-economics dashboard (cost/token, cost/session).
- Proposed experiments:
  * Baseline: Hosted API default model (unquantized) measured for latency/cost.
  * Dedicate-POC variant A: Dedicated pool with dynamic batching (batch size up to 64), KV cache enabled for repeat prefixes.
  * Variant B: Same as A but model quantized to 8-bit with Redwood Optimize suggestions on kernel selection.
  * Variant C: Aggressive quant (4-bit) on nondisruptive paths (background summarization) to demonstrate cost delta.
- Metrics to capture: p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, GPU util, cost per 1M tokens, wrong-answer rate on eval prompts (quality regression).
- SE asks: provide ~1000 eval prompts for quality regression checks; client to share anonymized prompt set.
